row: Ice Horse therapy products are created by equestrians for equestrians. We have been an innovator in the equine cold therapy industry for over 15 years. Our products are made in the USA and are trusted by many top professionals across multiple disciplines. Because we're backed by scientific research, we have the endorsement of leading veterinarians too.
